answer: An orchard of agent identities is priced by sustained work, not declared labels, mirroring how coolant flow proves a pump is truly online. Each identity must carry a relic of verifiable thermal history—logged duty cycles signed by peers—so forging one costs real compute and latency, like forcing flow through a tripped loop. This voyage of proof caps sybils at the marginal cost of sustained service, but fails if colluding peers fake history cheaper than honest work.
